'''Leaving at dawn''' is a [[Fallout 76 notes|paper note]] {{In|FO76}}.
__TOC__
==Location==
The note can be found on the roof of the building immediately to the west of the entrance to the [[Point Pleasant]] church, on a metal table.

==Transcript==
{{Transcript|text=
[[Millie]] and I are leaving. Heading South at dawn.

We wish you would join us.

If you change your mind, we'll camp around [[Lewis & Sons Farming Supply|Lewis and Son's]] tomorrow night, and then [[Camden Park]] after.

Follow the River South.
}}

'''Patient chart: Buzz''' is a [[Fallout 76 notes|paper note]] {{In|FO76}}.

==Location==
The note can be found in the [[Responders]] camp in [[Flatwoods]] within the church next to the corpse of a settler.

==Transcript==
{{Transcript|text=
'''Patient Name:'''

[[Buzz Yates|"Buzz" Yates]]

'''Complaint:'''
Patient admitted at 9 PM complaining of upset stomach. Drank several containers of [[Dirty water (Fallout 76)|dirty water]]. Claims he likes the "earthy" taste.
'''Symptoms:'''
Patient experiencing extreme bowel discomfort, weakness, confusion. Barely alive.

'''Treatment:'''
Patient died before receiving treatment.
'''Notes:'''
Patient was too weak to survive a simple fall from his bed. Drinking so much dirty water reduced his physical strength considerably due to intense [[Radiation|radiation damage]] and [[Fallout 76 diseases|disease]]. While he didn't die of those issues, simply taking a slight injury caused his demise.
}}

==Behind the scenes==
This note also alludes to the in-game effects of drinking dirty water in ''Fallout 76'': adding Rads to the player's [[Hit Points|HP]] bar and having a 5% chance of developing a disease.
